questions.history: Parse sub followed by -Dkey with null as the configured fallback.
questions.prediction: Issue #2035 reports a KEY=VALUE parse error before the change. On the merge parsing should succeed and produce a one-entry map containing key with null value.
questions.basis: The option explicitly assigns a fallback to a present key. Map.get alone cannot distinguish that result from an absent entry.
questions.refutation: Parsing fails, key is absent, or the value is the empty string instead of null.

questions.history: Give an explicit value as sub, -Dkey=actual.
questions.prediction: Both revisions should leave only key→actual in the parent map.
questions.basis: An explicitly supplied right-hand side does not consult mapFallbackValue.
questions.refutation: The parser uses the fallback anyway, drops the key or stores a modified value.

questions.history: Change the fallback to the empty string and compare otherwise identical root and subcommand invocations on fresh parents. Repeat with Option.NULL_VALUE.
questions.prediction: On the merge root and inherited parsing should agree for each setting. Both maps must contain key, with length-zero text under the first setting and null under the second.
questions.basis: Inheritance changes where the option can be spelled, while fallback belongs to the declared option. The two distinct map values expose an incorrect copy even when parse succeeds.
questions.refutation: The child silently substitutes null for the empty string, or either presence/value differs by invocation depth.
